generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The change removes the `assertAcked` method call and directly calls `.get(TimeValue.timeValueSeconds(30))` on the update settings request. This change could lead to issues because `assertAcked` is likely used to verify that the cluster acknowledged the setting update, ensuring that the operation was successful. By removing it, you lose this verification step, which might result in undetected failures.

review_comment:
I am a bit confused.

This says zen2 is default, however the actual constant value is `zen`:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/bcfbf000748b538884087623113682165abcb92d/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/discovery/DiscoveryModule.java#L63-L72

Anyways, even if it is using the different discovery type, is it safe to ignore ack?
The property is still used in couple of places as for 7.17, such as https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/bcfbf000748b538884087623113682165abcb92d/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/gateway/Gateway.java#L44

`zen` means Zen2, there is no option in 7.x to use the legacy discovery type.

Yes I believe this is safe, or at least it's no less safe than other things related to upgrading from 6.x. Which was never completely safe anyway.
